purpose: Fresh public training positions for learned discard correction; no evaluation roots recycled, no teacher selection or gradients in collection. Capture every eligible target-seat discard to support a stateless policy.

model.selection: Fixed original update79 parent derivative; not a winner selected from the new comparison.

snapshot0: Same pinned parent, greedy; the learner label marks the target observer, not a different network. All actor money visible.
pairing: Each count/opponent-family/deal repeated across all seats and four rules. Every instrumented game runs alongside an uninstrumented control; exact observations and terminal records required.
root_selection: Every target learner-seat multi-choice discard when max public cities >= end threshold minus3. No terminal result or subsequent moves used to select roots. No outcome rebalancing. Other seats never contribute roots even if controlled by the same frozen network.
split: Whole count/opponent-family/deal units. Indices0,4,8,12 reserved for validation with all seats, rules and repeated roots held together. Fixed before collection. Test/intervention/audit roots excluded by disjoint seed prefixes.
sampling_policy: Pinned parent float64 inference, batched greedy for collection. All2553 original fixture action choices match serial at batch32 and128; report is discard-training-batching-preflight-v1.json.
outputs: Every eligible sanitized public root with original proposal, engine legal menu and per-game ordinal.
All full terminal records retained only for coverage/cap validation, not root selection or discard labels.
Per-mode/count root coverage and exact twin-control observation/action/terminal-record checks.
labels: None in this collection. Freeze a separate teacher protocol after the complete intervention comparison; labels and optimizer work run only on HF Jobs.
